# Audience: external / general-public

| Knob | Setting |
|---|---|
| **Tone** | Open, plain, friendly. |
| **Reading level / jargon** | **Plain language, zero jargon.** Assume no education or tech background. |
| **Default theme** | Mode 1 (official), **light**. |
| **Density** | Low — big visuals, short lines, lots of breathing room. |
| **Formality** | Approachable and clear. |
| **`data-motion`** | `standard`. |
| **QR / poll / badge** | No polls by default. QR welcome for "learn more" or a contact. |
| **Preferred close** | A simple, friendly takeaway and where to find out more. |

## What to assume / emphasize
Lead with **big, clear visuals** and the human point — why it matters in plain
terms. Assume a general reader skimming, not studying. No insider context, no
acronyms.
